pages.title: Read the Reward Pool
pages.text: At the Identifier, choose Preview and select an unidentified drop. It lists eligible gear and each item's chance.$(br2)The pool respects tier, category, origin and boss provenance. It cannot show exact affixes or native jewelry patterns.

pages.title: Inspect Your Drops
pages.text: $(c:/tnkloot preview)$(bold)Open reward previews$(/c)$()$(br2)Choose a drop from your inventory to inspect it. Previewing never consumes it or rerolls its rarity.$(br2)Use $(bold)/tnkloot journal$() to reopen this guide. Craft the journal from a Book and an Amethyst Shard.
